summary: The face and camera push hold up, but the arms snap through fast poses in both strips and large flat confetti squares cross the frame at the cut.

faults.what: His left arm swings from raised beside the head (51.96) to across the belly (52.09) in about 4 frames. The forearm and hand jump between tiles with no ease, so the arm reads as snapping. The head also tilts and shifts at 52.06 to 52.09.
faults.fix: Add in-between frames or ease the arm move over the cut. Retime the arm so it doesn't swing so far in 4 frames.

faults.what: Large flat, unshaded red and green confetti squares pass close to the camera at the lower left (52.03, 52.06, 52.09). They read as unlit paper cutouts and are distracting.
faults.fix: Shade the confetti or make it smaller. Keep near-camera pieces out of the frame during the face push.

faults.what: At 52.33 to 52.43 the raised left arm, with its hand at the left frame edge, drops to low in front of the body in about 3 frames. This matches the spike at 52.333. The torso and head also shift position between tiles, so the whole body lurches.
faults.fix: Smooth the arm and torso curve across 52.33 to 52.43 and add in-betweens.

faults.what: His hand is cut off by the left frame edge at 52.33 and 52.36. The other hand sits at the bottom edge. The push-in is meant to be on his face, but the hands fight for attention.
faults.fix: Keep the gesture hands inside the frame or lower them out of the shot.

faults.what: From 52.46 to 52.56 the forearm lies flat across the chest and the pose barely changes. It reads mushy and hides his torso line, with no clear silhouette.
faults.fix: Hold a clear pose or open the hand away from the body.
